$comment: Tests run in Node, the app runs in a browser. Kept as a separate config so adding Node's globals to the test files does not also hand them to src/ — the app's browser-only surface is a guarantee worth keeping, and one shared `types` array would quietly retire it. src is compiled here too so its ambient module declarations (src/types/modules.d.ts) load — without them the world-atlas topology import loses its declared type and picks the wrong topojson overload. src keeps its browser-only guarantee because tsconfig.json still checks it WITHOUT node types, and typecheck runs that first.
